mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (member_id, total_price, status, receiver_name, phone, address) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{address})
INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, brand, product_name, price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{brand}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.member_id, o.total_price, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.phone, o.address, o.created_at, (SELECT oi.product_name FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id LIMIT 1) AS first_item_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS item_count FROM orders o WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT id, order_id, product_id, brand, product_name, price, quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
